atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation distributed 909 grants to 527 organisations and individuals in the 2019/20 financial year, totalling more than $12.5 million.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: The grants distributed in the 2019/20 financial year constituted 11% of the Australian Communities Foundation corpus and represented a 33% increase on giving from the previous financial year.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation provided an additional $2.8 million to support communities most impacted by the bushfires and Covid-19 during the 2019/20 financial year.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation is a community of giving that connects donors with people and organisations leading social, environmental and cultural change.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation describes its mission as activating a nation of givers for a fairer and more sustainable Australia.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation states that it is Australia’s only national community foundation.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation has more than 20 years of experience catalysing positive social and environmental change.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation’s giving community comprised more than 350 funds and foundations in the 2019/20 financial year, with 43 funds and foundations joining during that year.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation organises its giving into five key focus areas: tackling inequality, strengthening democracy, supporting Indigenous communities, safeguarding the environment, and building a culturally vibrant society; it also supports international aid and development.

qualifications: The evidence states the launch occurred in March, in the context of the 2019/20 financial year; the year 2020 is inferred from the surrounding Covid-19 context.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation offers Gumnut Accounts, allowing individuals to make regular tax-deductible donations toward a lasting endowment fund.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: A Gumnut Account can be opened with contributions of $500 per quarter or $2,000 per annum, with additional donations or increased regular contributions permitted.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: When a Gumnut Account balance reaches $20,000, it matures into a Named Sub-Fund.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation supports scholarship providers through Scholarship Funds to increase access to education and provide educational payments, prizes, and bursaries to students across Australia.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation supports collective giving across Australia and facilitates collaboration among givers.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation provides online donation services for fundraising events and recurring membership-fee payments.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Australian Communities Foundation has supported people and organisations to fundraise for diverse causes for more than 20 years and provides fundraising support to fundholders across Australia through nationwide licensing.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: The organisation supports organisations across Australia to establish and extend corporate and workplace giving programs.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: The organisation supports not-for-profits across the country through low-cost NFP Future Funds.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, the organisation's giving community gave more to Australian communities than ever before, including $2.8 million to support those most affected by the 2019/20 bushfire season and COVID-19.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, the organisation's community of 350 funds and foundations distributed 909 grants to 527 organisations and individuals, totaling $12,502,071.

atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, the organisation's largest grant was $380,000 and its average grant was $14,000.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, the organisation distributed $12.5 million in total funding grants across Australia.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, the organisation distributed $4,004,476 in grants to national projects and $5,996,061 to international projects.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, almost 40% of the organisation's $12.5 million in grants went to organisations working to tackle inequality, particularly in health and education.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, one quarter of the organisation's funding went towards supporting Indigenous communities.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: During 2019/20, one fifth of the organisation's funding went towards safeguarding the environment, particularly addressing climate change.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Following the 2019/20 Australian bushfire season, the organisation's giving community funded emergency response, recovery and policy reform, focusing on four strategic areas.

atoms.subject: Australian Communities Foundation Limited
atoms.proposition: Following the 2019/20 Australian bushfire season, the organisation's giving community distributed $2,199,150 across Indigenous-led crisis response; conservation, biodiversity and climate change; disaster prevention and response; public policy, research and advocacy; and other activities.
